We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of distinct methyl carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals (integrations). But we need integer count of methyl groups, not distinct types. Need total number of CH3 groups.

We can request proton NMR spectra. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input needed? It says takes SMILES string, but we have no SMILES. The tool signature: proton_nmr_spectra = (_: {}) => any. No parameters. So it will return spectra for sample at hand (the unknown). Good.

Let's call it.
